title: Commentary on Ecclesiastes (Tura papyrus) / «Толкование на Екклесиаста»
author: Didymus the Blind
genre: Exegetical lectures (classroom notes with student questions)
edition: Binder, Liesenborghs, Kramer, Gronewald et al., PTA (Habelt 1965–1983), with German translation. Not public domain.
ru_evidence: azbyka.ru Didymus page lists only 'Книга о Святом Духе'; ru.wikipedia 'Дидим Слепец' cites no translations
en_evidence: Open Library shows English only for Genesis (2016), Zechariah (2006), Job (2025) and the Psalm lectures (2024); none for Ecclesiastes
value: A unique stenographic record of a 4th-century Alexandrian classroom: student questions, philosophy and pagan learning, Origenist exegesis. Valuable for historians of education and philosophy, papyrologists and Origenism studies.
ai_feasibility: medium: lacunae and supplements must be marked rigorously; the conversational Greek is otherwise accessible.
